scope: Corollary 9.4 (A uniform phase compatibility margin) of the manuscript “A counterexample to the Colin de Verdière chromatic conjecture” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-the-Colin-de-Verdiere-chromatic-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 157 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 97677c7a183884f0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 64. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On either retained law of Theorem 9.3, for each fixed c ∈ F2 and all sufficiently large n, P{uB,1(∆A) = uB,2(∆A) = uA,1(∆B) = uA,2(∆B) = c} ≥ 1/32. (9.18) Also P{F(A, B) + F(B, A) = 0} ≥ .49, and each single prescribed phase bit has probability at least .49.
